text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Teio Sho is about to begin. I hear<n>a number of
people in the stands<n>discussing Shinko Windy.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Shinko Windy, huh. She did manage topull off a win in the February Stakes...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: That's 'cause the top contenderpulled out. Sure, Shinko Windy'sgood, but it's hard to root for her knowing she could get bitey at anyminute.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I wonder... From what I've<n>seen, it seems
like she's put that<n>biting incident behind her!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Old habits die hard, though. She's a<n>sore loser, so I
bet she has trouble<n>keeping her cool.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, welcome back, Trainer. What's<n>it like out
there?
choice_data_list: There's a lot of excitement in the stands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that while there are some<n>differing
opinions, for the most part,<n>people are seeing her in
a good light.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Which means some of those chumps<n>still think I'm
a menace, huh?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Give me a break already. How do I<n>get it through
their thick heads?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm a super strong supervillain! But<n>that doesn't
make me a cheater!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I've got real talent! And I'm<n>awesome!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just then, we hear a knock...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Windy! I've come to cheer you<n>on! How are
you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Biko! Came to watch me, didja?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's right—and I saw some of the<n>other dirt
racers in the stands, too.<n>Looks like everyone's
eager to see<n>what you can do.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
But enough about that. Did you see<n>today's Sports
News?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She holds her phone towards us. The<n>headline
reads...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"A Surprising Redemption?! Could the<n>Biting
Umamusume Secretly Be<n>Racing's Next Prodigy?! A
Review of<n>the G1 Dirt Scene in the Year's First
Half."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Headline aside, the article itself is<n>pretty positive. I
bet you'd really<n>enjoy reading it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hm? Well, might give it a look if I'm<n>bored. ♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. The world's starting to see<n>you in a different
light. The winds of<n>change are blowing!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And that means this is your chance!<n>Make them
regret having ever<n>doubted you!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm fully carotene charged and ready<n>to cheer you
on!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Already one step ahead of ya! I'm<n>gonna show
'em all what I can really<n>do.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'mma strike fear into their very<n>souls! Their knees
will tremble and<n>their teeth will chatter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy is bursting with<n>motivation as the
Teio Sho is set to<n>begin!
